mr_title: Made get_prep_lookup() pass output_field when wrapping direct values in Value.
mr_description:
Previously, only strings were supplied with an output_field when wrapping
direct value iterable elements in Value expressions for ExpressionList. This
caused problems for __in lookups on JSONField when using expressions
alongside direct values, as JSONField values can have different types which
need to be adapted by the field's get_db_prep_value().

Thanks Jacob Walls for the review.

expected_issues.title: Iterator right-hand side is consumed by any() before being iterated again
expected_issues.description:
any() consumes self.rhs before it is iterated again, so an iterator/generator passed to an __in lookup becomes empty and the query silently matches nothing.

get_prep_lookup() now scans `self.rhs` with any() and then iterates it a second time to build the ExpressionList or the prepared values. When the right-hand side is a one-shot iterator (e.g. `filter(field__in=(x for x in ids))` or `map(...)`), the first pass consumes it (partially or fully) and the second pass sees the remaining items only. The iterable must be materialised once (e.g. list()) before the two passes.
